# Carolina De La Cerda

Human Resources Business Partner at Cepheid and MBA graduate of the University of Michigan Ross School of Business. Interested in Senior HR Business Partner roles across manufacturing, operations, engineering and site leadership.

Professional portfolio: https://carolinadelacerda.com/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/carolina-delacerda/
Email: carodm@umich.edu

## Current scope
- Approximately 557 associates supported, including full-time and contingent workers, across day and swing shifts
- Advises leaders through VP level
- Employee relations, investigations, accommodations, performance management, engagement, compliance, leader coaching and workforce strategy

## Measurable results
- 20+ point engagement score improvement within three quarters
- 67% reduction in employee relations cases related to miscommunication
- 57% reduction in meal-break penalties and 32% reduction in rest-break penalties in about six weeks
- 100+ contingent workers involved in workforce classification initiative

## Education
- MBA, University of Michigan Stephen M. Ross School of Business, 2024
- Bachelor in Social Work, Universidad Tecnologica de Chile INACAP, 2012, First in Class
